titulo: Is Your Washing Machine Really Cheap to Run? #shorts
descripcion:
The washer itself uses about $13 of electricity a year, but ENERGY STAR says about 90% of the energy it takes to run a washer goes into heating the water.

Full ranking of 15 appliances by yearly cost: see the related video.
